pictures.observed: Northern oblique campus photo. The uphill detached building sits behind the archives range. Four large mullioned lights and small clerestory openings mark its raised west end. Three narrow punched-window rows, a central roof stair enclosure and low parapets continue east.
Southern aerial photo shows the square raised west roof, central access bulkhead, short western entry terrace and repetitive smaller windows above the courtyard.
Visitor map photograph explicitly labels the rectangular building south of the archives and library Administration and Research Building.
Official visitor illustration locates building 20 opposite the northern library, by the eastern access road and above the visitor plaza.
Overhead imagery matches the rectangular eastern access-road building and verifies the brighter raised western roof and central roof bulkhead. The PMTiles outline supplies fit.

identity: The two retained PMTiles fragments of OSM way 245189822 define the detached east-west footprint around native feature 35184617278654. The photographed visitor map labels this rectangle Administration and Research. North and south aerial views corroborate its raised western roof, central access bulkhead and distance from the adjoining school and library.
limitations: Roof heights, sill dimensions and smaller courtyard openings are estimated from the aerial photos. The central roof stair and the four-light western window group are specific to the pictured building.
The asset covers the exterior, with nearby terrain, paths and main campus volumes supplied by the host.
attribution: Photo references viewed only. No reference pixels are included in the asset.
